description: Search code on GitHub with the code search syntax, e.g. "addClass repo:jquery/jquery" or "org:acme filename:Dockerfile". Returns one page of matching files and a next_cursor; send that cursor back to read the next page. GitHub serves at most 1,000 results for one query.

cursor.description: The page cursor the previous call returned.

incomplete_results.description: GitHub sets this when it timed out before searching every repository it wanted to.

quirks.why_execute: The endpoint itself is a plain declarative call, but it carries its own secondary rate limit that the app record cannot express, so the node paces itself before every request. That pacing is code.
quirks.rate_limit: Code search allows 10 requests per minute for an authenticated caller, against 30 for every other search endpoint. The node spaces its own calls at 6 seconds. See wait_for_code_search_slot in github_requests.ts.
quirks.result_cap: GitHub serves at most 1,000 results for one query, so page 10 at 100 per page is the last page it answers. Asking for page 11 is a 422, so the node stops offering a cursor there.
quirks.authentication: Code search refuses unauthenticated callers outright.
quirks.secondary_limit_status: When GitHub does refuse for a secondary limit it answers 403 with a Retry-After header, not 429. The runtime's http_request reads 403 as `unauthorized` and does not retry it, so a caller sees a credential error where the true answer is "wait". Fixing that belongs in runtime/http_request.ts, which this connector does not own.
